steps.name: grill
steps.description: Interviews you about the design, and writes the glossary and the ADRs as they settle.

steps.name: gate
steps.description: Sums up the design and waits for your yes.

steps.name: write-spec
steps.description: Writes the spec from the settled design and publishes it to the Tracker.

steps.name: cut
steps.description: Breaks the spec into tickets, each with the tickets that block it.

steps.name: build
steps.description: Builds one ticket test first, and leaves the change uncommitted.

steps.name: standards
steps.description: Reviews the change against the rules and the review file for standards.

steps.name: spec
steps.description: Reviews the change against what the ticket and its spec asked for.

steps.name: architecture
steps.description: Reviews where the change sits, and runs the placement checks.

steps.name: fix
steps.description: Fixes what the three reviews found, or a Suite that went red.

steps.name: sweep
steps.description: Cuts the comments the comments rule does not keep.

steps.name: suite
steps.description: Runs every check in the Suite file, with no Session.

steps.name: finish
steps.description: Commits the ticket and closes it with its Closing note.
